entities.summary: Joshua Adrian Kronfeld is a New Zealand former rugby union player. He played as an openside flanker for Otago, the Highlanders and Leicester. At international level, Kronfeld played in 56 games for the New Zealand gaining 54 test caps, including appearances at the 1995 and 1999 Rugby World Cups.
